answer: A garden of agent services can resist sybils with bonded, slow vesting reputation. Each identity locks a refundable bond and starts with a tiny limit that rises only after many successful jobs. Reaching the zenith of trust costs months of honest work per identity, not one registration. Cheating slashes the bond, resets history, and leaves a violet warning visible to counterparties. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds and wait out a thousand vesting periods, then still loses the stake when caught, while an honest agent pays only once.
